reserveReview.rationale: Primary-source review on 2026-10-15 retains the unmeasured 100% strategy envelope and original 2026-10-03 economic-composition date. The XGLD Accountable response at 2026-10-15T10:31:32.186Z reports gross reserves of $12386709.43: Binance $12069895.62 and Bnb_smartchain $316813.81, against token-supply value $4226267.13. These figures describe gross venues, not a complete instrument inventory or debt-netted solvency. In particular, the response's cryptographic collateral/liability proof parameters are not shown to reconcile the borrowed-USDT obligations of the XGLD strategy. Primary docs still describe XAUt collateral, BYBIT borrowing, OES and delta-neutral strategies; no exact legal custodian, net allocation, contractual maturity maximum or reserve realization horizon is established. The seven-day holder cooldown is not a reserve-liquidity certificate. Platform terms and address disclosures concern USDu/sUSDu, not an identified XGLD issuing entity. No financial-assurance credit or measured parent-backing weight is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer strategy and gross Accountable venue disclosure; borrowed debt not netted
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Both live Accountable location slices lack exact economic-instrument inventories, complete obligor identities, contractual maturities and reserve realization terms in the XGLD-specific primary surfaces reviewed 2026-10-15. Gross location and cryptographic proof totals do not establish complete strategy-debt reconciliation. Borrowed liabilities, immediate legal custodians, segregation and net weights remain unestablished; the economic compositionAsOf is retained rather than refreshed from a location snapshot.
